descriptors.name: ledboost_baremetal
descriptors.label: Platform - LED Boost DCDC Bare-metal
descriptors.description: This example project demonstrates the DCDC boost LEDVDD behaviour with a self-driven loop that alternates between an EM0 ramp and an EM2 dwell. On odd iterations the app brings LEDVDD up at 1.8 V, ramps it to 3.8 V using the DCDC LEDVDDRAMPDONE interrupt for each step, and then powers the DCDC off. On even iterations the app parks LEDVDD at 1.8 V and drops the device into EM2 for a fixed dwell so the WSTK reads the EM2 current with LEDVDD held at 1.8 V.
